newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Santos plans A$270 mln rights issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Santos plans A$270 mln rights issue.

text.p: Oil and gas producer Santos Ltd said on Wednesday it planned to raise about A$270 million throughy a one-for-eight rights issue at A$4.00 a share.

Santos said the renounceable rights offering would help fund its major expansion programme, while maintaining the company's financial gearing at a sound level. The issue has been fully underwritten by E.L. & C. Baillieu Ltd and J.B. Were & Son.
The new shares will not participate in the recently announced final dividend of 13 cents a share for 1996.
Santos shares, which closed on Tuesday at A$4.89, were trading at A$4.69 at 11.10 a.m. (0010 GMT) on Wednesday.
Books closing and acceptances closing dates for the rights issue have yet to be announced.
